title: One phone, one driving session at a time
objective: Every sanctioned path that touches the phone (android_ui, phone_deploy.sh) is mutually exclusive across Claude sessions, with automatic expiry so no session has to remember to release, and a refusal that names the holder and the alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: A second session's android_ui call against a phone leased by another session waits up to 60 s then exits 3 naming the holder
The same session's calls refresh the lease without waiting
A lease untouched for 180 s no longer blocks anyone
python_pkg.phone_lease and python_pkg.android_ui keep 100% line and branch coverage
out_of_scope: Making two sessions drive the same screen concurrently (virtual display / emulator scripts cover that)
Raw adb commands, which bypass the tools
verifier: pre-commit run --files <changed> (pytest with --cov-fail-under=100), plus the two-session refusal reproduced on the real phone
